summary: Measured configuration for eight engineering-record categories: 279 definitions, 459 references, 159 mapped status occurrences with no status conflicts, and 55 dates. Remaining findings are documented source ambiguities and schema limitations.

categoryRationale.requirements: Retains the existing requirements key and replaces the unused REQ convention with FR IDs. Four specs define 49 functional requirements in leading bold list items (e.g. specs/001-spm-shared-code-plugin/spec.md:124). IDs restart per specs/* feature; only spec.md defines them.
categoryRationale.success: SC IDs identify 28 measurable success criteria in spec.md lists. The pattern includes the authored SC-002a suffix (specs/001-spm-shared-code-plugin/spec.md:149); each feature has its own scope.
categoryRationale.stories: User Story N headings define 16 user stories in the four feature specifications. US1-style task annotations resolve through a numeric ID template to User Story 1. Definitions are restricted to spec.md so task-section repetitions remain references; 228 references resolve.
categoryRationale.tasks: T-number IDs identify checkbox tasks in specs/*/tasks.md. Feature scopes prevent cross-feature collisions, checkbox-only definitions prevent dependency lists from redefining tasks, and suffixes are retained. All 140 definition occurrences are actual tasks. Seven IDs genuinely repeat within the test-architecture feature; removed workflow tasks have stale references.
categoryRationale.blockers: BL-001 through BL-003 identify explicit rollback-trigger conditions in specs/004-swift-crypto-update/spec.md:83–85. Leading list definitions and feature scoping yield three clean records.
categoryRationale.tests: PV, SV, SM, ZS, DE, NS, and IC IDs identify security test cases, not protocol or type names. Projects/README.md:49–76 supplies 26 current coverage definitions in its ID column; task design and feasibility tables remain references via definitionPaths. SM-003 is an acknowledged skipped case absent from that canonical coverage table; its five unresolved mentions are retained.
categoryRationale.phases: Phase N, including Phase 9.5, identifies 13 roadmap phases. Only level-one headings in .specify/memory/roadmap/*.md define phases. The shared .specify/mem* scope admits roadmap references while excluding unrelated workflow/template phases; all 89 references resolve.
categoryRationale.features: Feature Specification: title headings identify four named features in specs/*/spec.md. Keyword definitions capture names rather than branch numbers or version tokens and provide the correct attachment point for feature status metadata.

gaps.description: Task IDs T031–T037 are reused for distinct tasks within one feature. File/folder scopes cannot disambiguate these same-file records or their bare references; 14 duplicate occurrences remain.
The skipped CI workflow removed T013–T023 definitions but left range references. Four unresolved endpoint occurrences are preserved rather than inventing definitions.

Security test definitions span incompatible ID and Test ID tables; the latter also repeats exact IDs in feasibility summaries in the same file. The single table-column/definition-path configuration cannot combine these cleanly. SM-003 remains unresolved because it is omitted from current coverage and marked skipped elsewhere.

Completion marks and SKIP/DEFERRED qualifiers embedded in list-item descriptions are not supported status sites. Checkbox statuses remain literal Done/Open rather than guessing an override from prose.
Status paragraphs in task-section summaries and spike reports cannot update a story/task defined in another file. They remain separate evidence rather than overriding canonical definitions.
Dates in inline metadata after another field, version-history tables, and non-date-leading log entries are outside supported date sites.
The abbreviated date range 2025-12-08/09 cannot be represented faithfully by a single captured ISO date.

Research decisions use ordinary topic headings plus Decision paragraphs, risks use descriptive table cells, and acceptance scenarios use repeated ordered-list positions without stable IDs. No selective convention identifies these records without also matching unrelated sections or lists.

statusRationale: Enabled task-checkbox statuses and the authored COMPLETE heading suffix, plus a bounded Status: regex that reads contiguous values inside multi-line metadata paragraphs. Mapped Done/Complete/Implemented together and normalized decorated roadmap Planned, Future, and In Progress values. Evaluation maps all 159 occurrences: 140 checkboxes, 18 paragraphs, and one heading; no unmapped values or conflicts. All four features, 13 phases, and 133 distinct defined task IDs have statuses. No status is inferred for records lacking a supported authored status site.
dateRationale: Retained actual ISO-date headings and Created, Ratified, and Date fields; enabled Last Updated and Last Amended as snapshots. Removed zero-hit status-date and list-entry rules. Excluded Vendor (30 files), .devin (18), and .specify/templates (5). Inspected every enabled rule: 18 heading dates, 8 Created, 1 Ratified, 12 Date, 15 Last Updated, and 1 Last Amended. The ambiguous 2025-12-08/09 heading is deliberately excluded rather than reduced to a partial date.
